مُصَدِّقٌ One who accepts, admits, assents to, or believes, another in his information, or narration. (S, TA.) ＝
-A2- Also The exactor, or collector, (S, M, O, Msb, K, TA,) of the صَدَقَات, (S, O, Msb, K, TA,) i. e. (TA) of the حُقُوق [or dues, meaning poor-rates], (M, TA,) of the cattle, (Msb,) or of the sheep or goats, (S, M, O, TA,) and of the camels, (M, O, TA,) for the persons to whom pertain the shares [thereof]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
